assumptions: The file's $SPILLOVER describes how each dye spills into the other detectors on THIS acquisition.
A gate's coordinates are in the transform its Gating-ML dimension names.
limits: One file per call; batches, FlowJo workspaces (.wsp), spectral unmixing and clustering are not read.
A strategy written for other channel names refuses by name rather than gating the wrong channel.
bio.jane/contract.question: How many events fall in each gated population of this FCS file, and what are their per-channel intensities?

description: An FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 file from the project, end to end: read and linearize every event, compensate with the file's spillover, apply a Gating-ML 2.0 strategy from the project; every population's count, % of parent and % of all events, per-channel mean, median, SD and CV, a two-channel density for a plot, and a flowDensity deGate threshold on any channel, on the chosen display scale.

A.description: additional negative decades. Only applies when scale is logicle or hyperlog or flowcore-logicle or fasinh.

M.description: decades of the full scale. Only applies when scale is logicle or hyperlog or flowcore-logicle or fasinh.

T.description: top of scale; empty means the file's largest fluorescence $PnR.

W.description: linear width in decades. Only applies when scale is logicle or hyperlog or flowcore-logicle.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c (flowCore arcsinhTransform; flowTrans fits a and b). Only applies when scale is flowcore-arcsinh.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c; 1/b is a cofactor. Only applies when scale is flowcore-arcsinh.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c (flowTrans fixes it at 0). Only applies when scale is flowcore-arcsinh.

biex_negative.description: FlowJo biex extra negative decades. Only applies when scale is wsp-biex.

biex_width.description: FlowJo biex width basis (negative; FlowJo's default -10). Only applies when scale is wsp-biex.

biexp_a.description: the a of flowCore biexponentialTransform: y solves a·e^(b(y − w)) − c·e^(−d(y − w)) = x. Only applies when scale is flowcore-biex.

biexp_b.description: the b of flowCore biexponentialTransform. Only applies when scale is flowcore-biex.

biexp_c.description: the c of flowCore biexponentialTransform. Only applies when scale is flowcore-biex.

biexp_d.description: the d of flowCore biexponentialTransform. Only applies when scale is flowcore-biex.

biexp_w.description: the w of flowCore biexponentialTransform. Only applies when scale is flowcore-biex.

bins.description: bins per axis of the density.

clusters.description: populations made of FlowSOM nodes, as a JSON array of {name, parent, seed, channels, xdim, ydim, rlen, nClus, scale, outlierMAD, nodes}: the map is rebuilt from those settings and the population holds the parent's events in those nodes (1-based).

cofactor.description: the c in asinh(x / c): 5 is the CyTOF convention, 150 a common one for fluorescence. Only applies when scale is arcsinh.

compensation.description: `auto`: the file's own $SPILLOVER/$SPILL when it has one, else none; `file`: that, refusing a file without one; `none`: leave the values as acquired; `custom`: the matrix in `spillover`. Values: auto (automatic), file (file's own matrix), none (none), custom (custom matrix).

compensation_method.description: which published algorithm: FlowKit's solve(Sᵀ, Xᵀ) or flowCore's X · S⁻¹. They agree to ~1e-15 of full scale. Values: flowkit (solve(Sᵀ, Xᵀ) (FlowKit)), flowcore (X · S⁻¹ (flowCore)). Only applies when compensation is auto or file.

derived.description: derived parameters, `name = expression` separated by `;` (FlowJo's vocabulary: channels by name or [name], + − * / % ^, abs ceil floor neg round max min pow exp ln log sqrt and the trig functions); each becomes a channel of the run.

document.description: the FCS file, by name or id; may be left empty when the project holds exactly one.

early_exaggeration_iter.description: t-SNE iterations with the affinities multiplied by 12. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne.

embedding_channels.description: channels the embedding reads, separated by `;` (fluorescence on the display scale, scatter linear); empty for the file's fluorescence channels. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne or umap or optsne or embedsom.

embedding_events.description: at most this many of the population's events, drawn without replacement by the seed (numpy choice); 0 for every event. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne or umap or optsne or embedsom.

embedding_method.description: embed one population in two dimensions and join the coordinates to the run as two channels (tSNE-1/tSNE-2, optSNE-1/optSNE-2, UMAP-1/UMAP-2 or EmbedSOM-1/EmbedSOM-2) that plots, gates and statistics can name; empty for none. Values:  (none), tsne (t-SNE (Barnes–Hut)), fitsne (t-SNE (FFT interpolation, FIt-SNE)), umap (UMAP), optsne (opt-SNE), embedsom (EmbedSOM).

embedding_population.description: the population embedded; empty for all events. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne or umap or optsne or embedsom.

embedding_seed.description: the numpy seed of the sample, the initialisation's jitter and the layout. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne or umap or optsne or embedsom.

embedsom_adjust.description: EmbedSOM adjust: how much non-local pull between codes far apart on the grid is removed. Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

embedsom_k.description: EmbedSOM: neighbouring codes per event; 0 for EmbedSOM's rule 1 + ⌊√codes⌋. Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

embedsom_smooth.description: EmbedSOM smooth: positive smoother, negative rougher (at least -3). Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

gating.description: a Gating-ML 2.0 document or a FlowJo 10 workspace (.wsp) in the project, by name or id (from a workspace, the sample that is this file, matched by its $TOT, $BTIM, $ETIM and $DATE); empty for no gating (every statistic is then of all events).

lambda.description: λ of Box-Cox ((sign(x)·|x|^λ − 1)/λ, flowClust box) or of linlog (log above λ, the tangent line below); estimate_flow_cytometry_scale's flowTrans fit gives it. Only applies when scale is boxcox or linlog.

metrics.description: population metrics separated by `;`: `name = A / B` for the ratio of two populations' event counts (CD4/CD8), `name = A % B` for A as a percentage of B; A and B are population names, `All events` included.

min_dist.description: UMAP min_dist: how tightly neighbours may pack (a and b are fitted to it and the spread). Only applies when embedding_method is umap.

n_epochs.description: UMAP epochs; 0 for umap-learn's rule (500 up to 10,000 events, 200 above). Only applies when embedding_method is umap.

n_iter.description: t-SNE iterations after early exaggeration. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne.

n_neighbors.description: UMAP n_neighbors: larger keeps more global structure. Only applies when embedding_method is umap.

optsne_end.description: opt-SNE stop: end once the KL divergence changes by less than KL / this per iteration (auto_iter_end). Only applies when embedding_method is optsne.

optsne_max_iter.description: opt-SNE: the most iterations it may run (it usually stops well before). Only applies when embedding_method is optsne.

perplexity.description: t-SNE perplexity: the effective neighbours each event's affinities spread over (⌊3 × perplexity⌋ exact neighbours). Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or fitsne or optsne.

plot_population.description: the population plotted; empty for all events.

plot_x.description: channel (PnN or PnS) on the density plot's x axis; empty for no plot.

plot_y.description: channel on the plot's y axis.

scale.description: the display scale of the fluorescence channels (scatter and time stay linear): used for the plot, the threshold and, with `stats_on: scaled`, the statistics. Values: logicle (Logicle (Gating-ML 2.0, Moore & Parks)), fasinh (ArcSinh (Gating-ML 2.0 fasinh)), arcsinh (ArcSinh with a cofactor (asinh(x / c), Cytobank and CyTOF)), hyperlog (Hyperlog (Gating-ML 2.0, Bagwell)), flowcore-logicle (Logicle on a 0–M axis (flowCore)), wsp-biex (Biex (FlowJo 10, channels 0–4096)), flin (Linear (Gating-ML flin)), flowcore-arcsinh (ArcSinh, asinh(a + b·x) + c (flowCore, flowTrans)), boxcox (Box-Cox (flowClust, flowTrans)), linlog (Linlog (flowTrans)), flowcore-biex (Biexponential (flowCore, flowTrans)).

som_rlen.description: EmbedSOM: the map's training passes over the events (rlen). Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

som_xdim.description: EmbedSOM: width of the self-organising map's grid (FlowSOM SOM() xdim). Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

som_ydim.description: EmbedSOM: height of the map's grid (ydim); the grid needs at least xdim × ydim events. Only applies when embedding_method is embedsom.

spectral_matrix.description: A spectral matrix in this project (CSV: a detector header, then one row per fluorochrome), by file name or id: every fluorochrome is unmixed from the raw detectors (by unmixing_method) and added as a channel of its own name, which plots, gates and statistics can then name.

spillover.description: The `custom` compensation, a spillover matrix: an FCS $SPILLOVER value (n, the detectors, then the values row by row) or CSV/TSV with a detector header row. It must name exactly the file’s fluorescence detectors. Gates of the strategy keep the file’s own matrix.

spread.description: UMAP spread. Only applies when embedding_method is umap.

stats_on.description: statistics on linear compensated values (MFI) or on the display scale. Values: linear (linear values (MFI)), scaled (display scale).

theta.description: Barnes–Hut angle: larger is faster and coarser. Only applies when embedding_method is tsne or optsne.

threshold_channel.description: channel to find a density-valley threshold on (flowDensity deGate on the display scale); empty for none.

threshold_population.description: the population thresholded; empty for all events.

unmixing_method.description: `ols`: ordinary least squares (flowSpecs specUnmix); `wls`: detectors weighted 1 / max(|mean|, 125) (AutoSpectral unmix.wls); `poisson`: a per-cell identity-link Poisson fit started from WLS (AutoSpectral unmix.poisson). Values: ols (ordinary least squares), wls (weighted least squares), poisson (Poisson).

name: analyze_flow_cytometry

compensation.description: the spillover matrix used, its detectors and the algorithm, or null when the file has none

density.description: the two-channel density, events per bin, rows from the top of the plot

embedding.description: the embedding, when asked for: method, population, channels, the two axis channels, events embedded of the population, seed, every parameter it ran with, KL divergence (t-SNE) and time

file.description: version, event count, every channel with its role, range, gain and decades

metrics.description: every asked-for metric: its two populations and their events, the value, and the arithmetic in words

populations.description: every population: id, parent, event count, percent of parent and of all events

stats.description: per population and channel: count, mean, median, SD (n − 1), CV, min, max

threshold.description: every density-valley cut on the display scale and as scale values, and how many events lie at or above
